title: excerpt — corroborate

sentences.sentence: ...an excerpt from Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker.
sentences.translation: …柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子》选段。

translations.translation: 教唆， 煽动； 帮助， 支持

sentences.sentence: His wife was sentenced to seven years imprisonment for aiding and abetting him.
sentences.translation: 他的妻子因与他同谋被判决关押七年。

sentences.sentence: The minnow too had grown and had become a full-fledged fish.
sentences.translation: 此时的小鲦鱼也已长大，长成了一条年轻健康的鲦鱼。

sentences.sentence: Using a chicken feather as the body and some beads from a military ID tag as the eyes, I tied a fly that looked exactly like a minnow.
sentences.translation: 于是我用一根鸡毛做假饵的主体，用军籍牌上的一些珠子做眼睛，制作了一个看起来和小鱼一模一样的假饵。

sentences.sentence: A school of minnows swam by, each minnow with its small, individual shadow, doubling the attendance, so clear and sharp in the sunlight.
sentences.translation: 一群鲦鱼游过，每条都有虽小却不与众混淆的影子，阳光下清晰可观，从而一身两形。

sentences.sentence: His excuse was the platitude ‘boys will be boys.’
sentences.translation: 他还是那一套理由:“男孩总归是男孩。”

sentences.sentence: The play lacks subtlety.
sentences.translation: 这部戏不够精细。

sentences.sentence: She argued her case with considerable subtlety.
sentences.translation: 她非常巧妙地为自己的论点辩护。

sentences.sentence: His mother summoned him, upbraided him, wept and prayed.
sentences.translation: 他母亲把他叫来，责骂了他。然后母亲哭着做了祷告。

sentences.sentence: His landlord doubled the rent.
sentences.translation: 他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

translations.translation: 闹派别的； 好捣乱的

sentences.sentence: Many politicians are trying to ingratiate themselves with her.
sentences.translation: 很多政客都在试图讨她的欢心。

sentences.sentence: as the chairman said in his introductory remarks
sentences.translation: 正如主席在开场白中所说的

sentences.sentence: "They are drawing their inner buffoon, " explains the teacher.
sentences.translation: “他们在描绘自己内心的丑角，”老师解释说。

sentences.sentence: Dick Cheney appears less a brooding presence and more a red-faced buffoon, which may well be how history comes to regard him.
sentences.translation: 迪克。切尼似乎没有那么沉思，更多的像个面红耳赤的丑角，这也可能是历史对他的看法。

sentences.sentence: The pictures are worth about £10,000 apiece.
sentences.translation: 这些画每幅价值约一万英镑。

sentences.sentence: The two top teams have ten points apiece.
sentences.translation: 排名最高的两支球队各得十分。

translations.translation: 苍白的， 可怕的； 血红的； 耸人听闻的

sentences.sentence: lurid headlines
sentences.translation: 骇人听闻的标题

sentences.sentence: He told me in lurid detail what would happen to me.
sentences.translation: 他把我将会遇到的可怕事情详详细细地告诉了我。

translations.translation: 预先制止； 抢在…之前做或说

sentences.sentence: The law would preempt stronger local rules.
sentences.translation: 该法律将预先制止更强硬的地方性法规。

sentences.sentence: "the survival of the fittest," a slogan that virtually preempted all debate.
sentences.translation: “适者生存”，一个几乎无可辩驳的口号。

translations.translation: 磨， 把…放在磨石上磨

sentences.sentence: He set about honing his skills as a draughtsman.
sentences.translation: 他着手提高自己的绘画技艺。

sentences.sentence: Because be loved, proud Lin Lan cannot bear the grievance after be being misunderstood, cursory under put forward to part company.
sentences.translation: 因为被爱，骄傲的林岚不能忍受被误解后的委屈，草率之下提出分手。

sentences.sentence: He replied with characteristic insouciance: "So what?"
sentences.translation: 他用特有的漫不经心的口吻答道：“那又怎么样？”

translations.translation: 细心打扮， 过分装饰

sentences.sentence: She spends hours primping in front of the mirror.
sentences.translation: 她总是花很长时间在镜子前梳妆打扮。

sentences.sentence: We now have new evidence to corroborate the defendant’s story.
sentences.translation: 我们现在有新的证据来证实被告人的说法。

sentences.sentence: Experiments elsewhere corroborate these results.
sentences.translation: 其他地方的试验也证实了这些结果。

text:
英语词汇 · SAT · 第 369 单元

excerpt
音标：英 /'eksəːpt/  美 /'ɛksɝpt/
n.  摘录， 选录， 节录
例句：...an excerpt from Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker.
…柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子》选段。

abet
音标：英 /ə'bet/  美 /ə'bɛt/
vt.  教唆， 煽动； 帮助， 支持
例句：His wife was sentenced to seven years imprisonment for aiding and abetting him.
他的妻子因与他同谋被判决关押七年。

minnow
音标：英 /'minəu/  美 /'mɪno/
n.  鲤类小鱼
例句：The minnow too had grown and had become a full-fledged fish.
此时的小鲦鱼也已长大，长成了一条年轻健康的鲦鱼。
例句：Using a chicken feather as the body and some beads from a military ID tag as the eyes, I tied a fly that looked exactly like a minnow.
于是我用一根鸡毛做假饵的主体，用军籍牌上的一些珠子做眼睛，制作了一个看起来和小鱼一模一样的假饵。
例句：A school of minnows swam by, each minnow with its small, individual shadow, doubling the attendance, so clear and sharp in the sunlight.
一群鲦鱼游过，每条都有虽小却不与众混淆的影子，阳光下清晰可观，从而一身两形。

platitude
音标：英 /'plætitjuːd/  美 /'plætɪtud/
n.  陈词滥调； 陈腐
例句：His excuse was the platitude ‘boys will be boys.’
他还是那一套理由:“男孩总归是男孩。”

subtlety
音标：英 /'sʌtlti/  美 /'sʌtlti/
n.  微妙， 敏锐， 细微的区别
例句：The play lacks subtlety.
这部戏不够精细。
例句：She argued her case with considerable subtlety.
她非常巧妙地为自己的论点辩护。

upbraid
音标：英 /ʌp'breid/  美 /ʌp'bred/
v.  责备， 叱责
例句：His mother summoned him, upbraided him, wept and prayed.
他母亲把他叫来，责骂了他。然后母亲哭着做了祷告。

landlord
音标：英 /'lændlɔːd/  美 /'lændlɔrd/
n.  房东， 地主
例句：His landlord doubled the rent.
他的房东把房租提高了一倍。

factious
音标：英 /'fækʃəs/  美 /'fækʃəs/
adj.  闹派别的； 好捣乱的

ingratiate
音标：英 /in'greiʃieit/  美 /ɪn'ɡreʃɪet/
v.  使迎合， 使讨好
例句：Many politicians are trying to ingratiate themselves with her.
很多政客都在试图讨她的欢心。

introductory
音标：英 /ˌintrə'dʌktəri/  美 /,ɪntrə'dʌktəri/
adj.  引导的， 介绍的
短语：introductory course — 基础入门课程
短语：introductory remarks — 开场白；引言
例句：as the chairman said in his introductory remarks
正如主席在开场白中所说的

buffoon
音标：英 /bə'fuːn/  美 /bə'fun/
n.  小丑
例句："They are drawing their inner buffoon, " explains the teacher.
“他们在描绘自己内心的丑角，”老师解释说。
例句：Dick Cheney appears less a brooding presence and more a red-faced buffoon, which may well be how history comes to regard him.
迪克。切尼似乎没有那么沉思，更多的像个面红耳赤的丑角，这也可能是历史对他的看法。

caitiff
音标：英 /'keitif/  美 /'keitif/
adj.  卑劣的； 胆小的

apiece
音标：英 /ə'piːs/  美 /ə'pis/
adv.  每人， 每个
例句：The pictures are worth about £10,000 apiece.
这些画每幅价值约一万英镑。
例句：The two top teams have ten points apiece.
排名最高的两支球队各得十分。

lurid
音标：英 /'luːrid/  美 /'lʊrɪd/
adj.  苍白的， 可怕的； 血红的； 耸人听闻的
例句：lurid headlines
骇人听闻的标题
例句：He told me in lurid detail what would happen to me.
他把我将会遇到的可怕事情详详细细地告诉了我。

preempt
音标：英 /pri'empt/  美 /,primpt/
v.  预先制止； 抢在…之前做或说
例句：The law would preempt stronger local rules.
该法律将预先制止更强硬的地方性法规。
例句："the survival of the fittest," a slogan that virtually preempted all debate.
“适者生存”，一个几乎无可辩驳的口号。

hone
音标：英 /həun/  美 /hon/
v.   磨， 把…放在磨石上磨
n. 细磨刀石
例句：He set about honing his skills as a draughtsman.
他着手提高自己的绘画技艺。

cursory
音标：英 /'kəːsəri/  美 /'kə:səri/
adj.  仓促的， 草率的
例句：Because be loved, proud Lin Lan cannot bear the grievance after be being misunderstood, cursory under put forward to part company.
因为被爱，骄傲的林岚不能忍受被误解后的委屈，草率之下提出分手。

insouciance
音标：英 /in'suːsjəns/  美 /ɪn'susɪəns/
n.  漫不经心， 不在乎
例句：He replied with characteristic insouciance: "So what?"
他用特有的漫不经心的口吻答道：“那又怎么样？”

primp
音标：英 /primp/  美 /prɪmp/
v.  细心打扮， 过分装饰
例句：She spends hours primping in front of the mirror.
她总是花很长时间在镜子前梳妆打扮。

corroborate
音标：英 /kə'rɔbəreit/  美 /kə'rɑbəret/
v.  使坚固； 确证
例句：We now have new evidence to corroborate the defendant’s story.
我们现在有新的证据来证实被告人的说法。
例句：Experiments elsewhere corroborate these results.
其他地方的试验也证实了这些结果。
